messages:
maria: quick ask — opened a small PR to bring Ruby client streaming behavior closer to Go. CI passes everywhere except windows-ruby-3.1 job. can someone peek? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1234

leo: on it. what's the failure? flaky connect, timeout, or test assertion?

maria: failing on a test that asserts stream reconnect after transient ECONNRESET. locally can't repro on mac/linux. attached failing log: ```
# failing test snippet
E, [2026-03-15T10:12:34.567Z] ERROR -- Stream: read timeout after reconnect attempt 1
Faraday::TimeoutError: execution expired
```

ci-bot: windows-ruby-3.1 · test-streaming-reconnect failed (exit code 1). See job logs: https://ci.internal/builds/7890

anya: often Windows + OpenSSL + socket nonblocking differences cause different timing. Did you try increasing read_timeout or using `IO.select` fallback?

maria: I tried bumping the timeout in the test and the job still flaked (sometimes passes, sometimes fails). The code path uses `Net::HTTP#request` and a small custom read loop to maintain the KV cache.

sam: could be CRLF vs LF handling or Windows ephemeral port timing. Can you paste the tiny repro sample you used in the sampleapp?

maria: pasted minimal repro below — it's the sampleapp's streaming snippet with a loop that reconnects on Errno::ECONNRESET. ```ruby
require 'net/http'
uri = URI('http://localhost:8080/stream')
req = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
Net::HTTP.start(uri.host, uri.port) do |http|
  http.request(req) do |res|
    res.read_body do |chunk|
      puts chunk
    end
  end
end
```

leo: thanks. quick suggestion: wrap read loop in `while !http.finished?` and use `IO.select([socket], nil, nil, 0.5)` to avoid tight sleep on windows. also add a flakiness-aware test decorator: skip_when_env CI_WINDOWS_FLAKY=true?

anya: another approach — mirror Go client's behavior: call `socket.setsockopt(Socket::SOL_SOCKET, Socket::SO_KEEPALIVE, true)` before starting read. That reduced reconnection latency for our go -> grpc passthrough tests.

maria: good idea. I'll try sockets opts + IO.select. if that stabilizes, I can push a tiny change and add a note in the sampleapp README about Windows quirks.

sam: for reviewer pairing: @leo can you take the PR once updated? I'll help debug windows job if it still fails.

leo: yeah I can do a quick review after you push. if this becomes messy we can gate the flakey test behind an env var and open a follow-up bug to track root cause.

maria: thanks — pushing a branch with socket opts and test tweak now. also filing a tracking issue to align Crystal and Elixir community SDKs on streaming parity after this is stable.

ci-bot: maria pushed commit ~6s ago. windows-ruby-3.1 job retriggered.

maria: awesome, will report back in this thread once green. :fingers_crossed:

leo: :thumbsup:

anya: thanks for handling the sampleapp patch — small docs addition would help community contributors who run on windows.

maria: yup will add a short section titled "Windows streaming notes" to sampleapp README. closing loop once CI is green.
